# LanguageTool

> Multilingual grammar, spelling, and style checker with AI-powered paraphrasing for 30+ languages, available as browser extensions, desktop apps, and integrations for Microsoft Word, Google Docs, and LibreOffice.

LanguageTool is an open-source writing assistant developed in Germany that provides GDPR-compliant proofreading services. It offers browser extensions for Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Microsoft Edge, Opera, and Yandex, along with native desktop applications for Windows and macOS, serving millions of users worldwide with support for major languages including English, Spanish, French, German, Dutch, and Portuguese.

## Key Topics

- Grammar checking and correction
- Spelling and punctuation correction
- AI-powered paraphrasing and style improvement
- Browser extensions (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge, Opera, Yandex)
- Microsoft Word and Google Docs integration
- LibreOffice compatibility
- Desktop applications (Windows, macOS)
- Multilingual support (30+ languages)
- Open-source proofreading API
- GDPR-compliant processing
- Premium subscription features
- Academic writing for students
- Dialect and variant support
- Twitter and email integration
- Chrome Store and AppSource distribution

## Core Product & Platform

- [About LanguageTool](https://languagetool.org/pt/about): About page with company info, open source details, and career statistics
- [Premium Subscription](https://languagetool.org/ca/premium): Premium subscription pricing with FAQ and browser extension support
- [Spanish Grammar Checker](https://languagetool.org/es/corrector-ortografico-espanol): Spanish grammar and spell checker with browser extensions for 30+ languages

## Desktop Applications

- [Windows Desktop App](https://languagetool.org/de/windows-desktop): Windows desktop app with Outlook integration for grammar checking
- [macOS App (Italian)](https://languagetool.org/it/ios): macOS app for Apple Pages, Mail, and Slack with AI paraphrasing
- [macOS App (Russian)](https://languagetool.org/ru/mac-desktop): macOS app for Apple Pages, Mail, Slack with AI paraphrasing features

## Office Suite Integrations

- [Microsoft Word Add-in (French)](https://languagetool.org/fr/word-add-in): Microsoft Word add-in for grammar checking via AppSource integration
- [Microsoft Word Add-in (Russian)](https://languagetool.org/ru/word-add-in): Russian Microsoft Word add-in for grammar and style checking
- [Google Docs Add-on](https://languagetool.org/de/google-docs): Google Docs add-on for multilingual grammar and style checking

## Language-Specific Checkers

- [Dutch Grammar Checker](https://languagetool.org/ca/corrector-ortografic-neerlandais): Dutch grammar checker with dialect support for 30+ languages
- [Portuguese Spell Checker](https://languagetool.org/de/rechtschreibpruefung-portugiesisch): Portuguese spell checker with dialect options and browser extensions
- [German Grammar Checker](https://languagetool.org/ca/corrector-ortografic-alemany): German grammar checker with AI reformulation and dialect support
- [Spanish Spell Checker (Polish)](https://languagetool.org/pl/sprawdzanie-pisowni-hiszpanski): Spanish spell checker with browser extension and dialect selection
- [English Spell Checker (Polish)](https://languagetool.org/pl/sprawdzanie-pisowni-angielski): English spell checker with AI paraphrasing and punctuation correction
- [Dutch Grammar Checker (Ukrainian)](https://languagetool.org/uk/spellchecking-dutch): Dutch grammar checker with Ukrainian interface and browser extensions

## Education & Students

- [Student Solution (Dutch)](https://languagetool.org/nl/students): Dutch student solution with educational discount for academic writing
